item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem:
The table shows the number of houses on two streets of a town, Konini Street and Rimu Street.

| Street | Number of Houses |
| :--- | :--- |
| Konini | 30 |
| Rimu | 21 |

The pictograph below represents the number of houses in each street.

[Image: Pictograph]

How many houses does one [Image: House icon] represent?

Answer: ____

descriptors: Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

item.figure_description:
A pictograph with two rows:
- The first row is labeled "Konini St." and contains 5 identical outline icons of a house (a rectangular body with a triangular roof).
- The second row is labeled "Rimu St." and contains 3 identical full house icons and 1 half-house icon (a house sliced vertically down the middle, showing only the right half).

Below the pictograph, a single full house icon appears within the question text.
item.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1999 and 2003 eighth-grade mathematics data.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1999 and 2003 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1999 and 2003 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.
